title: Anti-Skin Aging Potential, Antibacterial Activity, Inhibition of Single-Stranded DNA-Binding Protein, and Cytotoxic Effects of Acetone-Extracted Passiflora edulis (Tainung No. 1) Rind Extract on Oral Carcinoma Cells.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究西番莲果皮提取物的抗衰老、抗菌及抗癌活性，虽涉及单链DNA结合蛋白(SSB)抑制和分子对接，但核心是植物提取物药理学，非蛋白质-DNA互作机制建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: The passion fruit, Passiflora edulis, recognized for its rich nutritional properties, has long been used for its varied ethnobotanical applications. This study investigates the therapeutic potential of P. edulis var. Tainung No. 1 rind extracts by examining their polyphenolic content (TPC), total flavonoid content (TFC), anti-skin aging activities against key enzymes such as elastase, tyrosinase, and hyaluronidase, and their ability to inhibit bacterial growth, single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB), and their cytotoxic effects on oral carcinoma cells. The acetone extract from the rind exhibited the highest levels of TPC, TFC, anti-SSB, and antibacterial activities. The antibacterial effectiveness of the acetone-extracted rind was ranked as follows: Escherichia coli > Pseudomonas aeruginosa > Staphylococcus aureus. A titration curve for SSB inhibition showed an IC(50) value of 313.2 mug/mL, indicating the potency of the acetone extract in inhibiting SSB. It also significantly reduced the activity of enzymes associated with skin aging, particularly tyrosinase, with a 54.5% inhibition at a concentration of 100 mug/mL. Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) analysis tentatively identified several major bioactive compounds in the acetone extract, including stigmast-5-en-3-ol, vitamin E, palmitic acid, stigmasterol, linoleic acid, campesterol, and octadecanoic acid. Molecular docking studies suggested some of these compounds as potential inhibitors of tyrosinase and SSB. Furthermore, the extract demonstrated anticancer potential against Ca9-22 oral carcinoma cells by inhibiting cell survival, migration, and proliferation and inducing apoptosis. These results underscore the potential of P. edulis (Tainung No. 1) rind as a promising candidate for anti-skin aging, antibacterial, and anticancer applications, meriting further therapeutic investigation.
abstract_zh: 西番莲（Passiflora edulis）以其丰富的营养价值而闻名，长期以来因其多样的民族植物学应用而被使用。本研究通过检测其多酚含量（TPC）、总黄酮含量（TFC）、对弹性蛋白酶、酪氨酸酶和透明质酸酶等关键酶的抗皮肤衰老活性，以及抑制细菌生长、单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB）的能力，及其对口腔癌细胞的细胞毒性作用，探讨了P. edulis var. Tainung No. 1果皮提取物的治疗潜力。果皮的丙酮提取物表现出最高的TPC、TFC、抗SSB和抗菌活性。丙酮提取果皮的抗菌效果排序如下：大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）> 铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）> 金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）。SSB抑制的滴定曲线显示IC(50)值为313.2 μg/mL，表明丙酮提取物在抑制SSB方面的效力。它还显著降低了与皮肤衰老相关的酶活性，尤其是酪氨酸酶，在100 μg/mL浓度下抑制率达54.5%。气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）分析初步鉴定出丙酮提取物中的几种主要生物活性化合物，包括豆甾-5-烯-3-醇、维生素E、棕榈酸、豆甾醇、亚油酸、菜油甾醇和十八烷酸。分子对接研究提示其中一些化合物可能是酪氨酸酶和SSB的潜在抑制剂。此外，该提取物通过抑制细胞存活、迁移和增殖并诱导凋亡，显示出对Ca9-22口腔癌细胞的抗癌潜力。这些结果强调了P. edulis（Tainung No. 1）果皮作为抗皮肤衰老、抗菌和抗癌应用的潜在候选物，值得进一步治疗研究。
